# Gargul

image

The all-in-one loot addon for World of Warcraft. GDKP, SoftRes, auto looting, auto rolling, TMB, DFT, and more. Works on Retail, Classic Era, and every flavor in between.

Only the loot master needs Gargul for most features. Raiders benefit from installing it too, but it's not required.

## Getting Started

```
/gl start
```

Run this in-game and Gargul walks you through everything: hotkeys, GDKP, SoftRes, auto looting, and auto rolling. No raid required, you can test every feature by yourself.

## What Can It Do?

|Feature |What it does |Command |
| --- | --- | --- |
|**GDKP** |Auction loot and split the gold.
Multi-auction lets you sell many items at once. |`/gdkp` or `/gl ma` |
|**SoftRes** |Import soft reserves from softres.it. Reserves show on tooltips and when rolling. |`/gl sr` |
|**Auto Looting** |Automatically send loot to the right player. Greens to DE, epics to ML, you name it. |`/gl pm` |
|**Auto Rolling** |Search for items and assign need, greed, or pass. Gargul rolls for you automatically. |`/gl autoroll` |
|**TMB / DFT** |Import wishlists and prio lists. Tooltip and roll integration. |`/gl tmb` or `/gl dft` |
|**Boosted Rolls** |Reward regulars with roll bonuses. |`/gl br` |
|**Plus Ones** |Track MS > OS +1 across raids. |`/gl po` |
|**Group Manager** |Auto-invite and sort groups from a raid signup. |`/gl gr` |

## Hotkeys

Use these on any item in your bags, loot windows, or chat links:

|Action |Default Hotkey |
| --- | --- |
|Roll out / Auction |`ALT_CLICK` |
|Award to a player |`ALT_SHIFT_CLICK` |
|Mark for disenchant |`CTRL_SHIFT_CLICK` |

\*\*Gargul v5.0.7\*\*

\## Major  
GDKP time gain: raiders using Gargul can now immediately see the loot you've queued up and can prepare and bid accordingly before the auctions have even started!
GDKP time gain 2: Added a 'what to do when no one bids' setting that allows you to automatically skip or disenchant unwanted items!  
Fixed an issue where rolls would not be accepted right when / shortly after a rolloff has ended

\## Minor  
Added an import prices command and settings button (`/gl ip`)  
Added an option that can add a delay between queued auctions  
Added a leeway setting to the GDKP settings menu  
Fixed a race-condition bug that would allow raiders to potentially snipe items when auto-award is active  
Made sure the highest bidder is only announced once when the announce in /rw setting is active  
Fixed an issue with alt-clicking in loot windows opening both the roll and auction window

\## Trivial  
Multiple minor UI improvements  
Fixed an issue with the GDKP auction queue explanations overlapping  
Got rid of the retail bag-related polyfills since it was causing too many issues  
Disabled libcustomglow in retail for now since it was causing errors

results.title: RCLootCouncil vs Gargul Which WoW Loot Addon Should You Use | by rengo | Medium
excerpts:
The two heavyweights in this space are RCLootCouncil and Gargul, and they approach the problem from completely different angles.

In this guide, you’ll learn:

* The fundamental philosophy behind each addon
* Detailed feature breakdowns with real testing results
* Which addon works best for different guild types
* Setup and configuration walkthroughs
* Common mistakes to avoid with each system
* My honest verdict after using both extensively

This guide is for raid leaders, loot council members, guild officers, and anyone who’s ever wanted to strangle someone over loot distribution.

## Understanding Loot Distribution Systems in 2026

Before we compare these addons, let’s talk about why loot distribution matters more than ever. With WoW Classic’s continued popularity and retail’s personal loot changes over the years, guilds have more options than ever for handling drops.

The two main approaches are:

...

The addon creates a structured voting interface where council members can see who’s interested in an item, what they’d use it for (main spec, off spec, minor upgrade), and make collective decisions. Everything is logged, creating accountability and transparency.

## My Testing Experience

I ran RCLootCouncil for two full raid tiers with a 25-person guild. The initial setup took about 45 minutes to configure properly, but once it was running, loot distribution during raids dropped from 5–10 minutes per boss to under 2 minutes.

The key was getting council members to actually use the voting system instead of just discussing in Discord. Once everyone committed to the addon’s workflow, decisions became faster and more defensible.

## Key Features

Voting Interface — Council members see a clean window showing all interested players, their current gear in that slot, and response options. You can customize response buttons to match your loot rules.

...

* Setup takes significant time investment
* Overkill for smaller groups or pugs

## Best For

Established guilds with dedicated raid teams, progression-focused groups where loot optimization matters, and any guild that’s had loot drama and needs a transparent system.

## Gargul Deep Dive

Press enter or click to view image in full size

## What It Is

Gargul is a more flexible loot distribution addon that excels at soft reserve integration, GDKP support, and streamlined roll tracking. It’s designed to make the master looter’s life easier without requiring complex setup.

## Why It Stands Out

Where RCLootCouncil is about structured decision-making, Gargul is about speed and automation. It integrates directly with softres.it and thatsmybis.com, automatically tracks rolls, and handles the tedious parts of loot distribution so you can focus on actually raiding.

## My Testing Experience

I switched to Gargul for a Classic raid team running soft reserve, and the difference was immediate.
Importing the SR sheet took literally 30 seconds — copy from the website, paste into the addon, done. During the raid, items with soft reserves got highlighted with animated borders so I never missed them.

The auto-trade feature alone saved probably 10 minutes per raid. When I awarded an item, the next time that player opened a trade window with me, the item automatically populated. No more “wait, which belt was yours again?”

## Key Features

Softres.it Integration — One-click import of soft reserve sheets. The addon knows who reserved what and automatically filters rolls accordingly.

Thatsmybis.com Support — For guilds using TMB for loot priority, Gargul pulls that data and displays it during distribution.

Auto Looting — Configurable packmule system that automatically distributes trash, crafting materials, and other items to designated players.

Trade Timers — Visual timers showing the trade window remaining on each item in your inventory.
You’ll never accidentally let an item become unshareable again.

Roll Tracking — Automatically captures /roll results, sorts them highest to lowest, and shows if someone rolled multiple times.

GDKP Support — Built-in tools for gold-bid runs, though that’s less relevant in 2026’s Classic landscape.

## Pros

* Incredibly fast setup and learning curve
* Best-in-class soft reserve integration
* Auto-trade feature is genuinely life-changing
* Trade timers prevent costly mistakes
* Works great without requiring raid-wide installation

## Cons

* Less structured than RCLootCouncil for complex decisions
* Voting system isn’t as robust
* History tracking is more basic
* Some features require master looter (Classic only)
* Less suitable for pure loot council systems

## Best For

Guilds running soft reserve, pug-friendly raids, GDKP runs, casual guilds that want simplicity, and any group that values speed over complex decision frameworks.

## Head to Head Comparison
| Feature | RCLootCouncil | Gargul | | — — — — -| — — — — — — — -| — — — — | | Setup Time | 30–60 minutes | 5–10 minutes | | Learning Curve | Moderate to Steep | Easy | | Soft Reserve Support | Limited | Excellent | | Loot Council Voting | Excellent | Basic | | History Tracking | Comprehensive | Adequate | | Auto-Trade | No | Yes | | Trade Timers | No | Yes | | Requires Raid Installation | Yes for full features | No | | Best For | Serious LC Guilds | SR/Casual Guilds |

## Which Addon Wins for Different Scenarios

## Progression Raiding Guild

Winner: RCLootCouncil

When you’re pushing mythic content or Classic hard modes, every piece of gear matters. You need to funnel items to players who will provide the most raid benefit. RCLootCouncil’s structured voting and detailed tracking make these decisions defensible and data-driven.

## Casual Weekly Raid Team

Winner: Gargul
If your guild raids once or twice a week and just wants to have fun, Gargul’s simplicity is perfect. Set up soft reserve, import the sheet, and let people roll. No drama, no complex systems, just loot distributed fairly and quickly.

## Pug Raids

Winner: Gargul

You can’t expect random players to install and configure RCLootCouncil. Gargul works even if you’re the only one with it installed. The roll tracking captures standard /roll commands, and soft reserve integration means pugs can participate through the website without any addon.

## Guild With Loot Drama History

Winner: RCLootCouncil

If your guild has had issues with favoritism accusations or loot disputes, RCLootCouncil’s transparency features are essential. The voting record shows exactly who voted for what, and the history log proves that loot has been distributed fairly over time.

## Classic WoW Raids

Winner: Gargul (slight edge)

With master looter still available in Classic, Gargul’s automation features really shine.
The packmule system, auto-trade, and direct softres.it integration make it the smoother experience. That said, hardcore Classic guilds still swear by RCLootCouncil for progression.

## Setup Walkthrough for Both Addons

## Setting Up RCLootCouncil

1. Install via CurseForge or your preferred addon manager
2. Type /rc config to open settings
3. Configure your council members under the Council tab
4. Customize response buttons to match your loot rules
5. Set up auto-pass rules for armor types your class can’t use
6. Test with your council before raid night
